title: Supabase chat app: rooms, members with roles, messages, reactions, read state
issue: The Slack-clone shape: every table is gated by 'is the user a member of the room (or is the room public)'. Policies cannot reference their own table (42P17), so docs and apps use per-row security definer helpers; the hot queries join and aggregate across protected tables (unread counts, LATERAL last message).
symptom: naive_rls (per-row volatile-style helper, nested RLS through messages for reactions) is far slower than best_practice_rls (InitPlan array of visible rooms); the array grows with the user's room count and public rooms. pg_auth replaces the helper with one room object (member or moderator or public).

scale.meaning: number of messages. rooms = scale/50, users = scale/20, reactions = scale, one room_reads row per membership. Room 3 is a public room holding 5% of all messages. At 10x (1M messages): 20k rooms, 50k users, 1M reactions, ~100k membership rows (OpenFGA tuples = memberships + public rooms + one per user with reads, so ~150k); room 3 holds 50k messages. All data comes from generate_series inserts.
